career_ladder.note: Junior Court Assistants (JCA) form the indispensable operational and registry staff of the Supreme Court of India, appointed under the Supreme Court Officers and Servants (Conditions of Service and Conduct) Rules, 1961. JCAs handle judicial filing, case scrutiny, listing of matters before constitutional benches, decree drafting, and courtroom assistance, with avenues of progression up to Registrar.

exam_scheme.note: The recruitment of Junior Court Assistants in the Supreme Court Registry is conducted across four distinct testing components: Objective Written Test, Computer Typing Speed Test, Descriptive English Examination, and Personal Interview.

financial_package.note: Junior Court Assistants are placed in Central 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 6 with an initial basic pay of ₹35,400. In addition to 58% Dearness Allowance, JCAs receive Delhi X-city House Rent Allowance (27%), Transport Allowance (₹3,600 + DA), Supreme Court Special Allowance, and Registry medical facilities.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Supreme Court of India — JCA Advertisement 2022 (F.3/2022-SCA/I) & 7th CPC Pay Matrix
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculations based on Level 6 basic pay of ₹35,400 + 58% DA (₹20,532) + 27% HRA (₹9,558) + Transport Allowance (₹3,600 + 58% DA = ₹5,688) + Supreme Court Registry allowances. In-hand reflects statutory deductions including 10% NPS employee subscription, CGHS medical contribution, and income tax TDS.
official_perks: Supreme Court Staff Residential Quarters in New Delhi (subject to seniority and vacancy)
Comprehensive Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) medical coverage and cashless hospitalization
Children Education Allowance (CEA) of ₹2,250 per month per child and annual hostel subsidy
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) as per Supreme Court of India Establishment norms
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% Central Government matching contribution
Access to Supreme Court Registry departmental cafeteria, recreational clubs, and credit society advances
